subject: Guest Wi-Fi network unavailable at OMR location - RTR-0058-01
description: Guest Wi-Fi network (SSID: ServeWell-Guest) has been completely non-functional since approximately 14:45 hours today. Customers are unable to connect to the network; devices display 'no internet' error after successfully joining the SSID. Internal staff Wi-Fi on the same NetLink NL-3000 router remains operational. No changes were made to the network configuration prior to the outage. Basic troubleshooting already attempted: (1) Power cycled the router twice with 2-minute intervals between cycles, (2) Verified ethernet WAN connection to modem is active and shows green status lights, (3) Checked guest Wi-Fi SSID broadcast settings in router admin panel - SSID broadcast is enabled. The guest Wi-Fi downtime is impacting customer experience and store reputation, as approximately 80-120 daily customers depend on this connectivity. Router asset RTR-0058-01 (NetLink NL-3000 v2.2) requires remote diagnostics or on-site inspection to identify root cause and restore service.

ticket_history.note: Ticket acknowledged and logged by Rajesh Kumar. Confirmed guest Wi-Fi outage with submitter; internal Wi-Fi operational. Scheduled remote diagnostic session for 16:00 hours. Requested store to document connected device count and any error messages displayed on client devices.

Remote connection established to RTR-0058-01 management interface. Guest Wi-Fi DHCP pool confirmed active but client devices reporting zero gateway connectivity. Preliminary assessment suggests potential WAN failover or DHCP-to-WAN routing misconfiguration post-power cycle. Escalating to L2 Network Engineering team for detailed packet analysis and configuration review.
